_comment: Applied by scripts/apply-sources.sh after the APKs in golden-state.json. Capture cannot see in-app repos: they live in private app data. Do not put accounts or tokens in this file.

manual.why: No add-repo intent. zangetsu:// is only anilist/mal/simkl auth, open, room, and pair. The nine installed providers are private app data; scripts/capture-app-settings.sh moves them (TorBox needs its key re-entered).
Content plugin is built into the APK. Nothing to provision.

JS plugins and Stremio add-ons live in Lumora's private data dir (allowBackup off); they are entered in Settings -> Plugins, not provisioned by APK. Full list, hashes and live steps in provision/lumora/README.md. Debrid key, Jellyfin account and ObnoxiousTV manifest are his to supply.
